rules.statement: A right of way can be acquired by user over an intervening land for the purpose of going from one land to another land of the same person, and such a servitude is not personal but praedial.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Roman-Dutch law is not a static system of law; but in the words of Lord Tomlin-\"a virile living system of law, ever seeking, as every such system must, to adapt itself consistently with its inherent basic principles to deal effectively with the increasing complexities of modern organized society\"."
